title: Statically Typed Rust Event System
description: semio/rs: Achieve a statically typed event system with the cleanest safe solution. Remove stringly typed event fields, model event cascades through typed hierarchical event scopes, extend the existing Rust test section only, and verify tests pass.
summary: Refactored semio/rs events to use entity-scoped typed field enums such as EventField::Connection(ConnectionField::Gap), EventField::Attribute(AttributeField::Value), and EventField::Kit(KitField::Name). Removed unscoped field variants and string-backed event field construction, added EventPath ancestry and KitEvent::Changed cascade support, wired connection field events through kit/design/connection paths, updated existing Rust tests to assert typed fields and the connection gap cascade, verified no old string field event patterns remain, and verified cargo check plus the full Rust test suite pass.
